condition: An in-place arithmetic op with a Python scalar (e.g. +=) on a small-dtype masked array raises _UFuncOutputCastingError under NumPy 2 (NEP 50), even though the same op works on a plain ndarray.
workaround: Cast the scalar to the array's dtype before the op (e.g. arr += np.uint8(5)), or apply the op to arr.data directly.
